## Mod Information

###### Mode: Summoners Rift & Aram

###### Author: Leischii

###### Mod version: 2.0.1

###### Description: Enables Pyke announcer on Summoners Rift and Aram. There is also an alternative version including the Bilgewater background music.

######

## Installation

To use this mod you have download 1 of the two files:
Either "Pyke Announcer" OR "Pyke Announcer + Music"
Do NOT use them in combination, you will get conflicts!
